item.text:
Every requirement maps to planned work below. **P01–P16 are provisional ticket labels**, not created Storybloq IDs. Inspecting this map changes nothing in the proposed setup.

| Source | Requirement | Planned coverage | Acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Brief: Background | 40 plots; March–October seasons | P02 registry, P12 map | Exactly 40 distinct plots; configured season dates displayed correctly |
| Brief: First version 1 | Apply for the coming season with up to three preferred plots | P06 applications | Valid application persists; invalid or excessive preferences fail clearly; retries create one application |
| Brief: First version 2 | Coordinator reviews applications and allocates plots | P07 allocation rules, P08 workspace | Coordinator reviews preferences and makes valid assignments; conflicting assignments fail safely |
| Brief: First version 2 | Unallocated applicants enter the waiting list in application order | P08 finalization, P09 waiting list | No applicant lost during finalization; queue preserves original submission order |
| Brief: First version 3 | Gardener sees their plot and season dates | P11 allocation view | Signed-in gardener sees accurate persisted allocation and dates |
| Brief: First version 4 | Gardener reports a problem with their plot | P13 problems | Authorized report persists; retry does not duplicate it |
| Brief: First version 4 | Coordinator views open problems and resolves them | P13 problems | Resolution removes a report from the open list while preserving its history |
| Brief: First version 5 | Coordinator sees a grid of 40 plots and holders | P12 map | Correct occupied/vacant states and holders; readable list alternative |
| Brief: Rules | At most one plot per household per season | P02 household identity, P06 applications, P07 allocation | Duplicate and concurrent assignments cannot violate the constraint |
| Brief: Rules | Eligible returning gardeners allocated before new applicants | P02 historical holdings, P07 rules, P08 workspace | Tests cover prior-season eligibility and applications before, at and after the cutoff |
| Brief: Rules | Waiting list strictly first come, first served | P09 waiting list | Only the head can be promoted; preferences and returning status cannot reorder it |
| Brief: Constraints | Works on phones | P04 prototype, P05 review, P06/P08/P11–P13 interfaces | Primary journeys demonstrated at phone widths |
| Brief: Constraints | Large text and plain language | P04/P05, all interface tickets, P16 acceptance | Readable labels, understandable errors, keyboard access and clear recovery paths |
| Brief: Constraints | Contact details visible only to coordinator | P02/P03 permissions, P12 map, P14 email, P15 operations | Direct-request authorization tests; no contact leakage through gardener pages, digest or logs |
| Your sign-in decision | Emailed one-time links; no passwords | P03 access | Single-use expiry, invitation, sign-out and verified address-recovery tests |
| Your notification decision | One daily coordinator email listing new reports | P14 digest | Scheduled delivery, empty-day handling, batching, retries and downtime recovery demonstrated |

The plan also includes supporting work inferred from those requirements:

| Supporting work | Tickets | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Application, database, email and verification tooling | P01 | Establish a runnable, testable foundation |
| Verified household enrollment and invitations | P02/P03 | Make household uniqueness and private access workable |
| Explicit allocation-round finalization | P08/P09 | Separate returning priority from strict waiting-list order |
| Deployment, backups, restore and audited corrections | P15 | Let the volunteer operate and recover the service |
| Owner reviews | P05, P10, P16 | Inspect the prototype, allocation demonstration and complete first version |

**Explicit deferrals:** online plot-fee payments and the tool-lending shelf remain outside the first version.

The cutoff safeguard remains included in the package; it has not been independently confirmed after the reviewer’s timing finding.

Independent review: revise, invocation R2

How should I proceed with this setup? Reply **Approve setup**, **Adjust the plan**, or **Inspect details**.

The story skill’s [setup-flow.md](/private/tmp/cc-cpm-w4-t536/onboarding-eval-WQjjxg/home/.agents/skills/story/setup-flow.md) requires: “Nothing is written before approval.” This inspection has created no project files.
